integrity: Every finite lower bound is an explicit code and every finite upper bound is an explicit clique partition of the full confusability graph. The bundled verifier regenerates channel descendants from the definition and checks both certificates.
scientific_limitations: Exact only for binary duplication length \(2\), two sequential errors, and source lengths \(2\le n\le8\). No statement is made for \(n\ge9\), for larger duplication length, or about classification of all extremal codes.
title: Exact binary two-\(\mathrm{PAL}_2\) code sizes through length eight
